channel.title: The Oasis
channel.description: Launch The Oasis and its games.

item.title: 🧸 Toy Box Smash Update: Platform fighting with your own avatar, slash trails and muzzle flashes
item.guid: 2026-10-17🧸 Toy Box Smash Update: Platform fighting with your own avatar, slash trails and muzzle flashes
item.description: Up to four fighters, percent cards with faces, Hero / Fighter / Gunner / Brawler styles, melee and ranged moves, custom slash colours. Tap to play.

item.title: 🎃 Harbor Haunt Update: Bubble-pop chat sounds + your own alert tones
item.guid: 2026-10-17🎃 Harbor Haunt Update: Bubble-pop chat sounds + your own alert tones
item.description: Chat now pops softly as you type, send and receive, with a chime when someone says your name. Pick your own sounds in Start menu > Sounds. Tap to play.

item.title: 🏍️ Garage Update: Ride your own bikes, in Oasis and Ryder X
item.guid: 2026-10-16🏍️ Garage Update: Ride your own bikes, in Oasis and Ryder X
item.description: Import any bike model, size it, set the rider's seat, hands and feet. Other players see your ride. Animated GIFs now work as picture furniture. Tap to play.

item.title: 🔨 Owner's Orders Update: Kick and ban from your own room
item.guid: 2026-10-15🔨 Owner's Orders Update: Kick and ban from your own room
item.description: Room owners can kick or ban players from their profile card. Log in straight into your Harbor Studio, or pick a default room in Decorate. Tap to play.

item.title: 🔫 Gun Workshop Update: Swap any gun for your own model
item.guid: 2026-10-14🔫 Gun Workshop Update: Swap any gun for your own model
item.description: Replace each Gunner weapon with a custom model and fit it to the hand. Tap to play.

item.title: The Oasis
item.description: PlayStation Home-style 3D social space. Load a VRM avatar, join lobbies, decorate your Harbor Studio, ride hoverboards and bikes.

item.title: Ryder X
item.description: Hoverboard and bike racing. Pick your rider, race the tracks.
